name: R-127-1 (Hubble)
blurb: R-127-1, an isolated ultra-diffuse galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: r1271-hubble
story: A ghostly galaxy as broad as a bright one but with only a thin haze of stars, drifting far from any crowd. It has stopped making stars and holds little gas, and astronomers still ask how a loner like this came to be so faint.

claims.text: R-127-1 is a low surface brightness galaxy targeted by Hubble program 14846 on ultra-diffuse galaxies
R-127-1 is a relatively isolated ultra-diffuse galaxy
Its properties are puzzling given its isolation
Ultra-diffuse galaxies are as large as bright galaxies but with few stars
